definition: A finite local pattern carried by a support witness, including canonical row, payload slots, and certificate-visible roles.
runtime_analogue: canonical structured schema row plus payload/certificate descriptors
mathematical_role: Basic object compressed by this operation
relation_to_current_operation: Input component of canonical motif compression
relation_to_payload_refinement: Motif payload can refine source payload only under declared mapping
caveat: General mathematical motif completeness remains outside this operation.

definition: Motif together with the proof/certificate fields used by obstruction or counterexample status.
mathematical_role: Prevents compression from ignoring certificate data
relation_to_current_operation: Compression must preserve or reduce proof motif
relation_to_payload_refinement: Status preservation depends on proof motif transfer

definition: Motif after canonical relabeling and selected normal-form ordering.
runtime_analogue: canonical sparse or structured local schema fingerprint
relation_to_current_operation: Compression source and target are canonical motifs
relation_to_counterexample_status: Canonical representative may still lose status

definition: Support coordinates used by the motif.
runtime_analogue: schema num and participating coordinate set
relation_to_current_operation: Support may decrease or remain fixed
relation_to_payload_refinement: Payload coordinates must map into compressed motif
relation_to_counterexample_status: Status certificate coordinates must map or reduce
caveat: Support preservation outside accepted compression is not proved.

definition: Payload fields attached to the motif.
mathematical_role: Connects motif rewrite to payload refinement
relation_to_current_operation: Compressed motif must carry refining payload

definition: Canonical ordering rank of the motif among motifs with fixed support size.
mathematical_role: Secondary decrease measure when support size is unchanged
relation_to_current_operation: Compression must strictly lower this rank if support is unchanged
relation_to_payload_refinement: Payload may be refined by lower-rank representative
relation_to_counterexample_status: Status may fail despite rank decrease
caveat: Rank soundness outside selected canonical row contract remains proof-sketch.

definition: A canonical motif with an accepted lower-rank representative preserving declared payload/canonical preconditions.
relation_to_payload_refinement: Payload preservation is a precondition or proof obligation
relation_to_counterexample_status: Status preservation is a precondition or blocker
caveat: Existence of a compressible motif for every witness is not proved.

definition: The lower-rank motif selected by the compression rule.
relation_to_payload_refinement: Payload should refine source motif payload
caveat: Only defined under accepted compression relation.

definition: Same canonical motif role up to accepted canonical row equality, not coordinate equivalence.
runtime_analogue: canonical row equality or refinement key
relation_to_current_operation: May justify rewrite but not support quotient
relation_to_payload_refinement: Payload equality/refinement can be checked at motif level
caveat: Motif equivalence is weaker than status equivalence.

definition: Compressed motif is no stronger than source motif for obstruction payload semantics and lower in selected measure.
No accepted lower-rank motif or missing preservation/congruence proof.
relation_to_current_operation: Routes to later operation or escape

definition: Compression output must be normalized back into support witness normal form.
mathematical_role: Ensures output is comparable under support measure
caveat: Normal-form preservation under motif rewrite not fully proved.

definition: Compressed motif may remain recognized family-chain source form only under layer compatibility.
relation_to_current_operation: Operation may feed family-chain lift status

definition: Motif compression should imply payload refinement when motif payload maps to compressed payload.
Compression must preserve counterexample status or construct a smaller status-refuting witness.
mathematical_role: Sharp semantic blocker for operation success
relation_to_payload_refinement: May use payload refinement as prerequisite

definition: If compression is unavailable or semantic preservation fails, the case is named for later higher-support or operation work.
Canonical motif notation is contract-ready with motif/rank/compression/failure notions first-class and status preservation open.
